tooltip.electricity.steel_plate: Rolled sheet. The body of every cabinet and the web of every frame.
tooltip.electricity.steel_section: Structural angle and tube. What a rack, a mast and a spar are built from.
tooltip.electricity.tempered_glass: Heat-treated low-iron glass. A module's front sheet, and the fibre in a blade.
tooltip.electricity.resin: Polymer film and epoxy. Laminates a module and binds a blade's fibre.
tooltip.electricity.copper_coil: Enamelled magnet wire, wound. Every winding in the mod starts here.
tooltip.electricity.silicon_ingot: Quartz reduced and cast. One step from sand to a solar cell.
tooltip.electricity.silicon_wafer: Sawn from an ingot. The blank a cell is made on and a die is cut from.
tooltip.electricity.busbar: Solid drawn bar. Carries the current a cable could not.
tooltip.electricity.solar_cell: A doped wafer with its fingers printed. Sixty of these make a module.
tooltip.electricity.bypass_diode: Carries a shaded substring's current so it does not become a heater.
tooltip.electricity.mc4_connector: The touch-proof plug and socket every string is joined with.
tooltip.electricity.junction_box: Bonded to a module's back: three bypass diodes and the leads out.
tooltip.electricity.power_module: Switching dies on a substrate. What actually turns direct current into alternating.
tooltip.electricity.capacitor_bank: The DC link. Holds the voltage steady between switching and the grid.
tooltip.electricity.magnetic_core: Laminated iron and a winding: the choke that smooths what switching leaves behind.
tooltip.electricity.control_board: The processor that tracks the maximum power point and answers the panel.
tooltip.electricity.bearing: Races and rollers. Everything in this mod that turns, turns on one.
tooltip.electricity.gear_set: Cut gears and a pinion, for a gearbox or a slew drive.
tooltip.electricity.gpv_fuse: A photovoltaic fuse: one per pole per string, and it breaks direct current.
tooltip.electricity.load_break_switch: Opens a live direct-current circuit without leaving an arc behind.
tooltip.electricity.sensor_head: A glass-domed element on a machined body: what a met station measures with.
tooltip.electricity.pv_laminate: Glass, film, cells and frame, cured into one piece. A module, ready to mount.
tooltip.electricity.enclosure: A sealed sheet-steel cabinet. What keeps the rain off the electronics.
tooltip.electricity.dc_section: Fuse ways, busbar and a load-break switch: the front end of a big machine.
tooltip.electricity.inverter_bridge: Power modules, DC link and magnetics on one busbar. One MPPT channel's worth.
tooltip.electricity.mounting_rack: Purlins, rails and clamps. What a fixed array is bolted to.
tooltip.electricity.torque_tube: The shaft a tracked row turns on, in its bearings.
tooltip.electricity.slew_drive: A geared bearing with a motor on it: what turns a tracker, a yaw deck or a pitch hub.
tooltip.electricity.generator_set: Stator windings round a rotor. Turns a shaft into three-phase current.
tooltip.electricity.gearbox: Three stages of gearing: takes a rotor's fifteen revolutions to a generator's fifteen hundred.
tooltip.electricity.turbine_blade: Glass fibre in resin over a steel spar. One of the three.
tooltip.electricity.long_blade: A blade extended: more fibre, a stronger spar, and the rotor that reaches low wind.
tooltip.electricity.abc_conductor: NFA2X 4x70. Four insulated cores on a messenger, 1 kV. Poles and street lines.
tooltip.electricity.mv_conductor: Aster 228 bare alloy conductor, 24 kV. One per phase, on pin insulators.
tooltip.electricity.hv_conductor: Curlew ACSR in a quad bundle, 420 kV. Four sub-conductors on spacers, for lattice towers.
tooltip.electricity.conductor.reach: %s blocks a reel, %s blocks a span at most
message.electricity.wire.not_enough: Not enough conductor: this span needs %s of %s
message.electricity.wire.already_connect: Those two fittings are already joined
